v1_boundary.ProtTox-3DKD v1: immutable strict deployment baseline; no code/checkpoint modification

motivation: MPCE-B supplies a sequence-only multi-view/multi-prototype architecture with higher MCC; frozen ProtTox-3DKD v1 supplies better AUPRC/Brier. This experiment trains MPCE-B from scratch with the same outer-safe 3D teacher soft targets instead of attaching a post-hoc residual to frozen v1.

model.name: MPCE-3DKD
model.architecture: MPCE-Net B unchanged: mean/max/std views each projected to 64d, PhysChem projected to 64d, mean*max/mean*std/max*std/mean*physchem low-rank interactions, 4 prototypes per class in 96d cosine space, z_final = z_global + sigmoid(alpha)*z_proto with alpha zero-initialized
model.deployment: sequence-only; 3D teacher and ESMFold are absent at inference

data.teacher_definition: strict-outer-fold single-structure GHXToxModel; teacher_outer{k} covers every sample outside student fold k; never emits student fold k
data.fold_scope: same audited 6387-row/5-fold manifest bound by the cache; Test1/Test2 never read

comparisons.A0: original TriStat-MLP no-KD OOF (existing runs/prottox_tsk_v1 mlp_fivefold*)
comparisons.A1: ProtTox-3DKD v1 frozen two-seed ensemble OOF (context only, immutable)
comparisons.B: MPCE-B no-KD existing OOF runs/mpce_net_b_seed20260905_v1 and seed20260906_v1

decision.pass: MPCE-3DKD is the recommended final patent architecture; ProtTox-3DKD v1 remains the immutable deployment baseline
decision.fail: MPCE-B is retained as the final patent architecture; MPCE-3DKD is recorded as the final ablation; ProtTox-3DKD v1 remains the immutable deployment baseline

final_recommendation_gate.product_gate: not applicable; this is the closing architecture experiment, not a product replacement
